```{r}
# 3. Función para limpiar tipos y columnas

delete_vars <- function(df, vars_to_remove) {
  # Convertir labelled a numeric para evitar errores
  df <- df %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ {
      if (inherits(., "labelled")) as.numeric(.) else .
    }))
  
  df <- df %>% select(-any_of(vars_to_remove))
  
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}
# Eliminar variables
vars_to_remove <- c(
  "urine", "dnrday", "surv2m", "surv6m", 
  "totmcst", "adlp", 
  "death", "d.time", "alb", "glucose", "bun"
)

train_tech <- delete_vars(train_tech, vars_to_remove)
test_tech  <- delete_vars(test_tech, vars_to_remove)

head(train_tech)
head(test_tech)

names(train_tech)
```
```{r}
# 4. Eliminar filas con nulos en variables clave

head(train_tech)
```

```{r}
# 1. Definir la función de la moda (necesaria para 'adls' y 'edu')
get_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(na.omit(x))
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

imputar_unknown <- function(df, col_name) {
  # 1. Convertir a carácter para evitar errores, añadir el nivel y volver a factor
  df[[col_name]] <- as.character(df[[col_name]])
  df[[col_name]][is.na(df[[col_name]])] <- "Unknown"
  df[[col_name]] <- as.factor(df[[col_name]])
  return(df)
}

# Imputación por "Unknown" para categóricas
train_tech <- imputar_unknown(train_tech, "race")
train_tech <- imputar_unknown(train_tech, "dnr")
test_tech  <- imputar_unknown(test_tech, "race")
test_tech  <- imputar_unknown(test_tech, "dnr")

# Imputación por Moda
# 1. Calculamos las modas del entrenamiento una sola vez
moda_adls   <- get_mode(train_tech$adls)
moda_edu    <- get_mode(train_tech$edu)
moda_sfdm2  <- get_mode(train_tech$sfdm2)
moda_income <- get_mode(train_tech$income)

# 2. Imputamos el train
train_tech$adls[is.na(train_tech$adls)]   <- moda_adls
train_tech$edu[is.na(train_tech$edu)]     <- moda_edu
train_tech$sfdm2[is.na(train_tech$sfdm2)] <- moda_sfdm2
train_tech$income[is.na(train_tech$income)] <- moda_income

# 3. Imputamos el test usando los valores del train
test_tech$adls[is.na(test_tech$adls)]     <- moda_adls
test_tech$edu[is.na(test_tech$edu)]       <- moda_edu
test_tech$sfdm2[is.na(test_tech$sfdm2)]   <- moda_sfdm2
test_tech$income[is.na(test_tech$income)] <- moda_income


# Imputación por Mediana Global (Lista de variables)
vars_mediana <- c("charges", "wblc", "bili", "ph", "pafi", "prg2m", 
                  "prg6m", "totcst")

for (var in vars_mediana) {
  if (var %in% names(train_tech)) {
    # 1. Convertir a numérico a la fuerza (si hay texto, lo convertirá a NA, lo cual está bien)
    train_tech[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(train_tech[[var]]))
    test_tech[[var]]  <- as.numeric(as.character(test_tech[[var]]))
    
    # 2. Calcular mediana solo sobre los datos existentes
    mediana_val <- median(train_tech[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # 3. Imputar
    train_tech[[var]][is.na(train_tech[[var]])] <- mediana_val
    test_tech[[var]][is.na(test_tech[[var]])]   <- mediana_val
  }
}
colSums(is.na(train_tech))
colSums(is.na(test_tech))
```

```{r}
# 1. Asegurar el target
train_tech$hospdead <- factor(train_tech$hospdead, 
                                 levels = c(0, 1), 
                                 labels = c("No", "Yes"))
test_tech$hospdead  <- factor(test_tech$hospdead, 
                                 levels = c(0, 1), 
                                 labels = c("No", "Yes"))

# 2. Convertir binarias categóricas que quedaron como 'num'
cols_to_factor <- c("diabetes", "dementia")

for(col in cols_to_factor) {
  train_tech[[col]] <- as.factor(train_tech[[col]])
  test_tech[[col]]  <- factor(test_tech[[col]], levels = levels(train_tech[[col]]))
}


# Verificación final
str(train_tech)
```

```{r}
# 2. Creamos los datasets escalados
train_tech_scaled <- train_tech
test_tech_scaled  <- test_tech

# Identificar columnas numéricas (excluyendo factores)
num_cols <- names(train_tech)[sapply(train_tech, is.numeric)]

# Aplicar escalado usando las estadísticas del train para ambos
for (col in num_cols) {
  mu <- mean(train_tech[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sigma <- sd(train_tech[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Aplicamos la fórmula: (valor - media) / desviación_estándar
  train_tech_scaled[[col]] <- (train_tech[[col]] - mu) / sigma
  test_tech_scaled[[col]]  <- (test_tech_scaled[[col]] - mu) / sigma
}

head(train_tech_scaled)
head(test_tech_scaled)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(test_tech_scaled,  "../data/processed/support2/df2/test_scaled.rds")
```
